title: Legends Says Goodbye
content: It was at the 2013 ESA Annual Meeting in Austin, Texas, that Mike Gray, Scott Hutchins, Kevin Steffey, and I found ourselves lamenting the passing of a colleague while reflecting on the many good memories of that friendship. We agreed that although some of our friend’s accomplishments in the entomological world would endure—research publications and the students he mentored—the lighter, more personal side of his life would quietly fade unless it had been intentionally captured. Good stories, after all, make for good memories.
